title: Tenants
intro: Each tenant on this Floorbit platform has its own accounts, floor plan, look, plugins and local agents. Nobody in one tenant sees another's data. This install's own tenant is "default".
defaultHelp: This install's own tenant. It runs the platform and can't be suspended.
suspendQuestion: Suspend {{name}}? Its Floorbit stops answering within 10 seconds: nobody can sign in, its agents are turned away and its public pages are gone. Its data stays, and you can take it back any time.
idHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and -, at most 40. It names the tenant's folder and can't change.
name: Name
urlHelp: Where its Floorbit answers. Your ingress sends this host name to its processes.
adminHelp: Makes this account with a password shown once. Leave empty to set it up on the tenant's first-run page.
madeHelp: Start its Floorbit from the same image and database with this setting:
madeAdmin: The password of {{admin}}, shown only now:
docs: How tenants run, and what keeps them apart: docs/tenancy.md.
setAdminHelp: A new account is made as Admin. An existing one becomes Admin, gets a new password and is signed out everywhere. In the tenant's audit log.
adminMade: Added {{admin}} as admin. The password, shown only now:
adminReset: {{admin}} is admin with a new password, shown only now:
